notes.title: Christmas carp
notes.content:
The recent barking fix reminded me how fun updating HROT is, so I got on a roll.

Ver. 1.3:

 fixed doubled sound when picking up a pistol
 player's voice de-noised (never record voices into the game while the dishwasher is running in the room)
 Pterodactyl drops amphorae instead of gifts
 fixed oversized gib in Supreme Commander-in-chief's stomach
 some new maps in Bombermod
 GoBack button in the Menu (upper left corner)
 another river in my country has been poisoned -> the body proportions of the Bečva fish have changed
 Infested Rider has a 50% chance to drop a Bubblebum. Bubblebum adds 5 hp 1 second after picking it up (it will make a bubble first). Just like that.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37662475/c779cbf5396d2be90fcb2fd6d5b99ba963c72752.gif

I haven’t mentioned for a long time (new players might not know), that the console command silvestr will launch fireworks (do not indoors). This feature is especially useful at the end of the year.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37662475/b1aa19122ab87fdf6a4f02215aae35e0c56910a1.gif

And finally, a fun fact - Before I became a game developer, I was a confectioner:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37662475/3097ad9daa1d5448284f3a997701b304fe0b1a7b.jpg


Enjoy your carp

notes.title: YOU ARE CORDIALLY INVITED BY SPYTIHNĚV TO A
notes.content:
CELEBRATORY HROT RELEASE

WHICH WILL TAKE PLACE ON TUESDAY, MAY 16, 2023, AT THE FACTORY CLUB


Program:

 The Song of Labor
 Opening and welcoming the attendees
 Cultural performance
 Presentation of the National Committee
 Director's speech
 Conclusion


https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOWU5ZDMxMTg0ZmY2NDY2OTliZjc5ZDY5NWI0ODUxMTkzYmIzNTNhNiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZzX2dpZklkJmN0PWc/ENCNFxPpRF2XDe3fAe/giphy.gif


HROT Full Version 1.0

 3 Episodes, 26 levels + 4 endless arenas
 Recipes instead of a story
 Over 50 monster types (only Daikatana has more?)
 Unique stuff in each level
 Trains, horses, Prague Ratters .....



https://store.steampowered.com/app/824600/HROT/

fixed a few texture glitches
 removed shotgun pumping
 fixed clean briefs bug  
 achievement "Bestiary" increased to 40
 +9 achievements

Added E3M1 "War with the Newts", inspired by Karel Čapek's novel with Wolf3D references and with a functional spinning top, which sounds great as always.

In addition new experimental features:
- You can deflect grenades with footkick
- A bottle of wine can be thrown as a Molotov instead of a grenade
- Zoom key, you can see how ugly it looks up close. But be careful if you already have Mouse3 button mapped to another function.

What next? 
Full game will be released on 21May (in case of speedrun dev) or 22Jun (more likely). This will be further specified. 
I wish you a nice Sunday!

-Pes

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
Changelog 0.2.6 - 0.2.8

https://i.ibb.co/RjXJpnS/update1-20.gif

NEW WEAPONS

 ball lightning launcher (secret experimental Soviet battery-powered weapon), sharing ammo with lightning gun, do not use underwater
 double barrel shotgun called BRNO (shares ammo with original shotgun and consumes 2 rounds as you expect)



GAMEPLAY

 new powerup: Calvaria of Čáslav - player deal double damage for 30 sec
 improved sickle melee - faster and deal more damage
 SMG reload removed
 force pistol reload via weapon switch
 monsters drowning underwater (except Bečva and Head)
 blue soldier (Skapuci) doesn't shoot immediately after teleport in
 electric cabinet gives more ammo
 added electric cabinet into Endless map
 miner and pedro appear in Endless
 cheats disabled in Endless 


FIXES

 fixed pink glitch from evacuation elevator (Palace of Culture)
 removed all unkillable monsters that were out of maps
 turrets and helicopters no longer bleed



MISC

 splashing when monster falls into water
 bindings for weapons
 improved pistol and shotgun sounds (thx to SquidTheSid)
 improved Lightning Gun model
 pistol reload polishing
 level stat in top right corner (default=off)
 heartbeat can be turn off (default=on)
 spiders can be turn off (default=on; available only in main menu and change does not affect savegames)
 added console access through menu Options/Global 
 several new sounds 



Hope you will have some fun!

- Enjoy!


AND THANK YOU
for all your forum posts, streams, comments, Tweets, feedback, everything!
